title: Archipel Doodles
text:
Archipel’s visual identity gradually became inseparable from the doodles I created over the years.

What began as carefully rendered drawings slowly evolved into something more instinctive and distilled. The lines became freer, more essential, sometimes drawn in a single gesture — frame after frame — embracing spontaneity over precision.

These animations were conceived as playful visual anchors, both on Instagram and online. They carry a deliberate sense of naivety and warmth, echoing something tender and familiar in all of us. Beyond decoration, they became a subtle emotional layer within the brand, bringing rhythm, personality and quiet cosiness to the experience.
